text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, say to the prince of Tyre, Thus says the Lord God : Because your heart is proud and you have said, “I am a god; I sit in the seat of the gods, in the heart of the seas, ” yet you are but a mortal, and no god, though you compare your mind with the mind of a god.
text_cn: “人子，你要向提洛的王子说：吾主上主这样说：因为你心高气傲地说：‘我是神，我在海心坐在神位上。’其实，你只是人，而不是神，你心中却自以为是神。

text_en: You are indeed wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you;
text_cn: 看，至于明智，你胜过达尼尔， 任何秘密都不能隐瞒你。

text_en: by your wisdom and your understanding you have amassed wealth for yourself, and have gathered gold and silver into your treasuries.
text_cn: 你凭你的智慧和聪明发了财，把金银储满你宝库。

text_en: By your great wisdom in trade you have increased your wealth, and your heart has become proud in your wealth.
text_cn: 你在贸易上凭你的丰富智慧，不断增加你的财富；因你的财富，你便心高气傲，

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you compare your mind with the mind of a god,
text_cn: 为此吾主上主这样说：因为你心中自以为是神，

text_en: therefore, I will bring strangers against you, the most terrible of the nations; they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and defile your splendor.
text_cn: 为此，看，我要率领外方人，即列国最蛮横的人来攻打你，他们要拔出剑来攻击你以智慧所得的美丽，玷污你的光华，

text_en: They shall thrust you down to the Pit, and you shall die a violent death in the heart of the seas.
text_cn: 将你抛入深渊，使你在海中遭受惨死。

text_en: Will you still say, “I am a god, ” in the presence of those who kill you, though you are but a mortal, and no god, in the hands of those who wound you?
text_cn: 在杀戮你的人面前，你还敢说‘我是神’吗？在击杀你的人手中，你只是人，而不是神。

text_en: You shall die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners; for I have spoken, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 你必在外方人手中死去，像未受割损的人死去一样：这是我，上主说的 —— 吾主上主的断语。”

text_en: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, raise a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say to him, Thus says the Lord God : You were the signet of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
text_cn: “人子，你要为提洛的王子唱哀歌，哀悼他说：吾主上主这样说：你原是一个完美的模型，满备智慧，十分美观。

text_en: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering, carnelian, chrysolite, and moonstone, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald; and worked in gold were your settings and your engravings. On the day that you were created they were prepared.
text_cn: 你曾住在“伊甸” —— 天主的乐园内，有各种宝石作你的服饰，如赤玉、青玉、金钢石、橄榄玉、红玛瑙、水苍玉、蓝玉、紫宝石、翡翠；衣边和绣花是用金做的，在你受造的那天，都已准备好了。

text_en: With an anointed cherub as guardian I placed you; you were on the holy mountain of God; you walked among the stones of fire.
text_cn: 我曾立你为革鲁宾，作光耀的守卫，在天主的圣山上，在烈火的石中往来。

text_en: You were blameless in your ways from the day that you were created, until iniquity was found in you.
text_cn: 从你受造之日起，你的行为原是齐全的，直到你犯了罪之时。

text_en: In the abundance of your trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned; so I cast you as a profane thing from the mountain of God, and the guardian cherub drove you out from among the stones of fire.
text_cn: 因你生意兴隆，你就充满了欺压，犯了重罪，因此我从天主的山上将你赶走，从烈火石中将你这作守卫的革鲁宾铲除。

text_en: Your heart was proud because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor. I cast you to the ground; I exposed you before kings, to feast their eyes on you.
text_cn: 你因美丽而心高气傲，为了你的光耀，你失去了智慧，所以我要把你抛在地上，叫你在列王面前出丑。

text_en: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your trade, you profaned your sanctuaries. So I brought out fire from within you; it consumed you, and I turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all who saw you.
text_cn: 因你罪过众多，因你经商不公，亵渎了你的圣所，所以我要使火由你中间冒出，将你烧毁，在众目昭彰之下，使你成为地上的尘埃。

text_en: All who know you among the peoples are appalled at you; you have come to a dreadful end and shall be no more forever.
text_cn: 万民中凡认识你的，都因你而惊骇。你将成为恐怖的对象，且永远不复存在。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
text_cn: “人子，你应面向漆冬，讲预言攻击她，

text_en: and say, Thus says the Lord God : I am against you, O Sidon, and I will gain glory in your midst. They shall know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in it, and manifest my holiness in it;
text_cn: 对她说：吾主上主这样说：漆冬，看，我要攻击你，在你中间受光荣；当我对她施行惩罚，对她显示我的圣善时，他们必承认我是上主。

text_en: for I will send pestilence into it, and bloodshed into its streets; and the dead shall fall in its midst, by the sword that is against it on every side. And they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我要在她境内散发瘟疫，使血倾流在街市上，刀剑由四周向她袭击，伤亡的人横卧在她中间：这样，他们必承认我是上主。

text_en: The house of Israel shall no longer find a pricking brier or a piercing thorn among all their neighbors who have treated them with contempt. And they shall know that I am the Lord God .
text_cn: 以色列的四邻中，为以色列家族再没有刺人的荆棘和恼人的蒺(jí)藜(lí)，敢于轻视他们：这样，他们必承认我是上主。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and manifest my holiness in them in the sight of the nations, then they shall settle on their own soil that I gave to my servant Jacob.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“当我把分散在各民族中的以色列家族聚集起来时，我要在异民眼前，在他们身上显示为圣：他们要住在我所赐予我仆人雅各伯的地域内。

text_en: They shall live in safety in it, and shall build houses and plant vineyards. They shall live in safety, when I execute judgments upon all their neighbors who have treated them with contempt. And they shall know that I am the Lord their God.
text_cn: 他们要安全地住在那里，建造房屋，栽植葡萄园；当我向一般轻视过他们的四邻施行惩罚时，他们必平安地住在那里。那么他们必承认我，上主，是他们的天主。”
